It must match this JSON Schema (props variant: kv-list):

RULES:
- `elements` is a flat list. `root` is the id of the top element; `children` lists child ids in display order.
- Write `root` first, then elements parent-before-child, so the UI can render while streaming.
- Each prop is {"key": <prop name>, "value": <string>}. Strings go in as-is; numbers, booleans and arrays go in as JSON text, e.g. {"key":"rows","value":"[[\"Ada\",120]]"}.
- Omit optional props you do not need. Leaf elements use "children": [].
- Only use the components below. Include realistic sample content.

AVAILABLE COMPONENTS:
- Stack: { direction?: "vertical" | "horizontal", gap?: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" } - Flex layout. Vertical by default; horizontal wraps. [accepts children]
- Grid: { columns?: "1" | "2" | "3" | "4", gap?: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" } - Responsive grid of children. [accepts children]
- Card: { title?: string, description?: string } - Bordered surface with optional title and description; children go in its body. [accepts children]
- Heading: { text: string, level?: "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "h4" } - Section heading.
- Text: { text: string, variant?: "body" | "lead" | "muted" | "small" } - Paragraph of text.
- Button: { label: string, variant?: "default" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | "destructive" | "link", size?: "sm" | "default" | "lg" } - Button.
- Input: { label?: string, placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "search" | "tel" | "url", value?: string } - Labelled text field.
- Select: { label?: string, placeholder?: string, options: Array<string>, value?: string } - Dropdown of string options.
- Table: { columns: Array<string>, rows: Array<Array<string | number>>, caption?: string } - Data table: column headers and rows of cells.
- List: { items: Array<string>, ordered?: boolean } - Bulleted or numbered list.
- Stat: { label: string, value: string, change?: string, trend?: "up" | "down" | "neutral" } - Single metric with optional change and trend.
- Image: { src: string, alt: string, aspect?: "square" | "video" | "wide" | "auto" } - Image from an http(s) URL.
- Badge: { text: string, variant?: "default" | "secondary" | "outline" | "destructive" } - Small status label.
- Chart: { type: "bar" | "line" | "area" | "pie", data: Array<{ label: string, value: number }>, title?: string } - Single-series bar, line, area or pie chart.
- Tabs: { tabs: Array<string>, value?: string } - Tab strip; switching tabs is local. Child i is the panel for tabs[i]. [accepts children]
- Checkbox: { label: string, checked?: boolean } - Labelled checkbox.
- Switch: { label: string, description?: string, checked?: boolean } - Labelled on/off toggle with optional helper text.
- Textarea: { label?: string, placeholder?: string, value?: string } - Labelled multi-line text field.
- RadioGroup: { label?: string, options: Array<string>, value?: string } - Single choice from string options.
- Progress: { label?: string, value: number } - Progress bar, value 0-100, with optional label.
- Avatar: { name: string, src?: string, size?: "sm" | "default" | "lg" } - Round avatar; shows the name initials when there is no image URL.
- Alert: { title: string, description?: string, variant?: "default" | "destructive" } - Inline notice with a title and optional description; destructive for errors.
- Separator: {  } - Thin horizontal divider.
- Accordion: { items: Array<string> } - Collapsible sections. Child i is the content for items[i]. [accepts children]

DESIGN BRIEF (applies to every UI you produce):
- Build a complete, realistic screen, not a skeleton: a clear title and intro, grouped sections, and enough detail that it could ship.
- Cover exactly what the request names, with no extra pages or marketing sections.
- Use the supplied DATA in full: every field is there to be shown. Derive useful extras from it (shares, totals, deltas, rankings) instead of inventing unrelated numbers.
- Where it fits, add status badges, trend/change figures, secondary actions, helper text, and sensible empty or edge-case copy.
- Establish hierarchy with headings, size and weight; group related items; keep spacing and alignment consistent.
- Make charts readable: a title, labelled axes or values, and a legend for pie charts.
- Never use lorem ipsum or placeholder names like "Item 1".
